name: Paul Krugman
role: American economist, Nobel laureate (2008) and New York Times columnist
summary: Krugman is a Keynesian economist and progressive commentator who argues for government action against recessions, opposes austerity, and supports universal health coverage, stronger unions and higher taxes on the rich. He favours open trade and a strong case for climate action, and criticises movement conservatism.
